components.name: Signal Surface
components.html:
Side-project lab

Trevisoft is where experiments become products.

Useful tools, web experiments and small digital products built with the same care as client work.
components.css: .ds-signal { align-items: center; background: linear-gradient(115deg, oklch(68% 0.26 337 / 13%), transparent 42%), linear-gradient(255deg, oklch(88% 0.15 200 / 10%), transparent 42%), oklch(20% 0.06 303); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, oklch(97% 0.012 315) 16%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 24px 80px oklch(8% 0.025 294 / 42%); color: oklch(97% 0.012 315); display: grid; font-family: Saira, Aptos, Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; gap: clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; justify-self: end; max-width: 860px; overflow: hidden; padding: clamp(1.1rem, 3vw, 1.5rem); position: relative; width: min(100%, 860px); } .ds-signal::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(68% 0.26 337), oklch(88% 0.15 200)); content: ""; height: 2px; inset: 0 0 auto; opacity: 0.8; position: absolute; } .ds-signal-eyebrow { color: oklch(88% 0.15 200); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 650; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-signal strong { display: block; font-size: 1.38rem; font-weight: 760; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-signal p { color: oklch(80% 0.055 298); line-height: 1.62; margin: 0.35rem 0 0; max-width: 58ch; } @media (max-width: 820px) { .ds-signal { grid-template-columns: 1fr; max-width: none; width: 100%; } }

narrative.overview:
This system should feel like a polished personal lab where serious frontend craft is surrounded by signal, music, and motion. The page is a brand surface, not an app shell: the name, portrait, professional claim, and Trevisoft path must read instantly, while the animated details make the visit stick.

The atmosphere is dark because the scene is closer to an after-hours creative workstation than a daylight corporate profile. The palette stays close to the original synthwave love: electric cyan, hot magenta, deep violet, and a rare acid-green pulse. The improvement is restraint, not reinvention.
keyCharacteristics: Personal first: name, role, portrait, and links are the product.
Technical but lively: interactions should demonstrate frontend taste.
Compact by design: one page, quick scan, no bloated resume maze.
Lab energy: Trevisoft, audio, and social links support the lead-engineer story.

rules.name: The Signal Budget Rule
rules.body: Cyan and magenta can be loud, but they must point at identity, state, or action. Decorative glow without information is prohibited.

rules.name: The No Generic Neon Rule
rules.body: Do not add purple-blue gradients by category reflex. Every saturated moment must be traceable to Marco, Trevisoft, audio, social presence, or product craft.

rules.name: The One Display Voice Rule
rules.body: Audiowide belongs to the hero identity. Do not spread it across routine UI labels or body copy.

rules.name: The Working Sans Rule
rules.body: Saira carries all readable text. It should feel like a technical workshop label, not a default SaaS paragraph.

rules.name: The Natural Case Rule
rules.body: Eyebrows and signal labels keep their written case. Do not force long technical labels into all caps.

rules.name: The Glow Means State Rule
rules.body: Glows should communicate hover, focus, active audio, or a timed signal. Static glow everywhere makes the page feel cheaper.

rules.name: The Docked Signal Rule
rules.body: Trevisoft is secondary but memorable. It should peek into the first viewport as a deliberate lower-right signal, not sprawl across the full page like a footer.

dos: Do keep the first viewport centered on Marco's name, role, portrait, and primary next steps.
Do let motion demonstrate craft: pointer tilt, scanning lines, audio state, and subtle particles are valid when they preserve legibility.
Do keep focus states thick, visible, and cyan-forward.
Do use the current 8px radius for buttons, surfaces, and icon controls unless a component is explicitly a chip or circular control.
Do connect Trevisoft to the lead-engineer story rather than treating it as an unrelated promotion.
Do preserve the asymmetric desktop rhythm: identity left, portrait right, Trevisoft signal docked lower right.
Do keep Audiowide reserved for the hero name and use Saira for every readable UI and prose role.
donts: Don't drift into a generic corporate portfolio.
Don't use the bland SaaS hero-metric template.
Don't imitate an overproduced neon or crypto aesthetic.
Don't make the page a static resume page that hides the human signal.
Don't add dense navigation or content that makes visitors hunt for the primary contact path.
Don't use side-stripe borders, decorative glassmorphism, or gradient-clipped text in UI work.
